text:
molly: Quick check — RFC review tomorrow morning. We have 4 RFCs queued but only a 45m block (10:00–10:45 PT). Can people confirm availability and whether they need >10m for their review?

jen: I can make 10–10:45. I need ~12 mins for the storage-pool rfc (slides + 2 min demo).

dylan: +1 for 10. I can take a ~8 min slot for the rollout-policy RFC.

sara: I have a conflict 10:00–10:20 PT, available after 10:20. If we can reorder I can present the auth-cache RFC at ~10:22.

alex: I can be flexible. If we need to reorder to accommodate sara, I can swap my slot with jen. No strong preference.

molly: Ok swapping sounds fine. Proposed order: 1) rollout-policy (dylan) 8m, 2) storage-pool (jen) 12m, 3) auth-cache (sara) 10m, 4) backpressure-handling (prateek) 10m + 5 min buffer for quick Qs. That sums to 45. Thoughts?

prateek: That ordering works. Quick note — my RFC has a short perf chart. Would be helpful if people skim the perf section beforehand.

jen: I'll move my pre-read to the top of the thread and add 2 bullet takeaways. Will upload slides by EOD.

molly: Reminder: pre-reads by EOD please. For the meeting agenda I'll post a concise runbook. Also tagging @dylan and @sara: if either of you expects follow-ups that need a separate deep-dive, call it out now so we don't squeeze it into the 45m.

dylan: No follow-up planned. If reviewers want more we can schedule a follow-up session next week.

sara: I might need a follow-up if we decide to change token TTLs. I'll add that as an action item in my pre-read.

molly: Sweet. Draft agenda (copy/paste to calendar invite):

```
10:00 — 10:05   Quick sync + lane checks (molly)
10:05 — 10:13   Rollout-policy RFC (dylan) + 2 min Q
10:13 — 10:25   Storage-pool RFC (jen) + 3 min Q
10:25 — 10:35   Auth-cache RFC (sara) + 2 min Q
10:35 — 10:45   Backpressure-handling (prateek) + wrap/actions
```

molly: I'll update the invite order accordingly. If anyone needs more time, say so now or we schedule a follow-up.

deploy-bot: Reminder: calendar invite for "eng RFC reviews" updated with new agenda order (10:00–10:45 PT).

jen: Thanks — uploaded slides + TL;DR under the thread.

prateek: Uploaded perf snippet too.

molly: Great. Last ask — please react with :thumbsup: when you've read the pre-reads. I'll take reactions as the green light for tomorrow.

alex: :thumbsup:

dylan: :thumbsup:

jen: :thumbsup:

sara: :thumbsup:

prateek: :thumbsup:
